why: The signup trial is granted by the database, not by handle_new_user() and not by any file in migrations/: the BEFORE INSERT trigger trigger_set_trial_dates on public.profiles calls public.set_trial_dates_on_profile_insert(), which fills trial_started_at = now() and trial_ends_at = trial_started_at + INTERVAL '<n> days' when they are NULL. Trial length is an owner decision (money): this file records it and never changes it.
